#!/bin/bash

# ==============================================================================
# --- Arguments Definition ---
# Module: key
# Defines CLI arguments for the Bitwarden wrapper with subcommand structure.
# ==============================================================================

function arguments {
	# Subcommand selection
	arg_value @command \
		--description "Subcommand: get, set, remove, list" \
		--option "get # Retrieve password or field value" \
		--option "set # Add or update a custom field" \
		--option "remove # Remove a custom field" \
		--option "list # List all items"

	# Item name - with autocomplete from rbw list
	arg_value @item \
		--description "Bitwarden item name" \
		--option-cmd "rbw list 2>/dev/null || echo ''"

	# Field name for custom field operations
	arg_value @field \
		--description "Custom field name (optional for get, required for set/remove)" \
		--depends-on "ARG_COMMAND"

	# Value for set operations
	arg_value @value \
		--description "Value to set (prompted if not provided)" \
		--depends-on "ARG_COMMAND"

	# Field type for new fields (hidden, text, bool)
	arg_value @type \
		--description "Field type: text, hidden (password), or bool" \
		--option "text # Plain text field" \
		--option "hidden # Hidden/password field" \
		--option "bool # Boolean field" \
		--depends-on "ARG_COMMAND"

	# Flag to copy output to clipboard instead of stdout
	arg_flag @copy \
		--description "Copy result to clipboard instead of printing to terminal"

	# Flag to force overwrite existing fields
	arg_flag @force \
		--description "Force overwrite if field already exists"
}

#!/bin/bash

# ==============================================================================
# --- Main Execution ---
# Module: key
# Bitwarden wrapper with subcommands: get, set, remove, list.
# Supports custom fields and clipboard operations.
# ==============================================================================

declare -r CMD_PASS_VAULTWARDEN="vaultwarden"
declare -r BW_EMAIL="mycont79-homenetwork@yahoo.com"
# Wir verwenden das bestehende state/ Verzeichnis im Projekt-Root
declare -r STATE_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/../" && pwd)/state"
declare -r SESSION_FILE="${STATE_DIR}/bw-session"

# ==============================================================================
# --- Internal Helper Functions ---
# ==============================================================================

# Checks if a command exists and exits if not.
function _check_cmd {
	local cmd="$1"
	if ! command -v "$cmd" &> /dev/null; then
		lx output --error "Error: $cmd is not installed."
		exit 1
	fi
}

# Copies text to clipboard using the available tool.
function _copy_to_clipboard {
	local text="$1"
	
	if command -v wl-copy &> /dev/null; then
		echo -n "$text" | wl-copy
		lx output --ok "Copied to clipboard (wayland)"
	elif command -v xclip &> /dev/null; then
		echo -n "$text" | xclip -selection clipboard
		lx output --ok "Copied to clipboard (xclip)"
	elif command -v xsel &> /dev/null; then
		echo -n "$text" | xsel --clipboard --input
		lx output --ok "Copied to clipboard (xsel)"
	else
		lx output --warn "No clipboard tool found (install wl-copy, xclip or xsel)"
		echo "$text"
	fi
}

# Unlocks rbw using expect and pass.
function _unlock_rbw {
	if ! rbw unlocked &> /dev/null; then
		lx output --info "Unlocking rbw..."
		
		local vault_pass
		vault_pass=$(pass show "${CMD_PASS_VAULTWARDEN}" | head -n 1)
		
		if [[ -z "$vault_pass" ]]; then
			lx output --error "Failed to retrieve vault password from pass."
			exit 1
		fi

		expect <<EOF
log_user 0
spawn rbw unlock
expect "Master Password:"
send "${vault_pass}\r"
expect eof
EOF

		rbw sync &> /dev/null
		lx output --ok "rbw unlocked successfully."
	fi
}

# Unlocks bw (Bitwarden CLI) with persistent session.
function _unlock_bw_persistent {
	mkdir -p "$STATE_DIR"
	
	if [[ -f "$SESSION_FILE" ]]; then
		export BW_SESSION=$(cat "$SESSION_FILE")
	fi

	if bw status 2>/dev/null | jq -e '.status == "unlocked"' >/dev/null; then
		return 0
	fi

	lx output --info "Bitwarden locked. Unlocking..."

	local vault_pass new_session
	vault_pass=$(pass show "${CMD_PASS_VAULTWARDEN}" | head -n 1)
	
	if [[ -z "$vault_pass" ]]; then
		lx output --error "Failed to retrieve vault password."
		exit 1
	fi

	new_session=$(bw unlock --raw --passwordenv VAULT_PASS 2>/dev/null)
	
	if [[ -z "$new_session" ]]; then
		bw logout &>/dev/null
		new_session=$(bw login "$BW_EMAIL" --passwordenv VAULT_PASS --raw 2>/dev/null)
	fi

	unset VAULT_PASS
	
	if [[ -n "$new_session" ]]; then
		echo "$new_session" > "$SESSION_FILE"
		chmod 600 "$SESSION_FILE"
		export BW_SESSION="$new_session"
		lx output --ok "Bitwarden unlocked."
	else
		lx output --error "Failed to unlock Bitwarden."
		exit 1
	fi
}

# Gets item JSON from Bitwarden with fuzzy search fallback.
function _get_item_json {
	local item_name="$1"
	local output_var="$2"
	local item_json
	
	if item_json=$(bw get item "$item_name" 2>/dev/null); then
		eval "$output_var='$item_json'"
		return 0
	fi
	
	local search_json
	if ! search_json=$(bw list items --search "$item_name" 2>/dev/null); then
		lx output --error "Item '$item_name' not found."
		return 1
	fi
	
	search_json=$(echo "$search_json" | jq --arg term "$item_name" '[.[] | select(.name | test($term; "i"))]')
	local count
	count=$(echo "$search_json" | jq 'length')
	
	if [[ "$count" -eq 0 ]]; then
		lx output --error "Item '$item_name' not found."
		return 1
	elif [[ "$count" -eq 1 ]]; then
		item_json=$(echo "$search_json" | jq '.[0]')
		eval "$output_var='$item_json'"
		return 0
	else
		if command -v fzf &> /dev/null; then
			local selection
			selection=$(echo "$search_json" | jq -r '.[] | "\(.name) [\(.login.username // "no-user")] (\(.id))"' | fzf --prompt="Select item: ")
			if [[ -n "$selection" ]]; then
				local id
				id=$(echo "$selection" | sed 's/.*(\(.*\))/\1/')
				if item_json=$(bw get item "$id" 2>/dev/null); then
					eval "$output_var='$item_json'"
					return 0
				fi
			fi
		fi
		lx output --error "Multiple items found. Use exact name or install fzf."
		return 1
	fi
}

# ==============================================================================
# --- Command Dispatchers ---
# ==============================================================================

# Handles 'get' command - retrieve password or field value.
function _cmd_get {
	local item_name="$1"
	local field_name="$2"
	local copy_mode="$3"
	
	if [[ -z "$field_name" ]]; then
		_unlock_rbw
		
		local result
		if ! result=$(rbw get "$item_name" 2>/dev/null); then
			lx output --error "Failed to retrieve password for '$item_name'"
			exit 1
		fi
		
		if [[ "$copy_mode" -eq 1 ]]; then
			_copy_to_clipboard "$result"
		else
			echo "$result"
		fi
		return 0
	fi
	
	_check_cmd bw
	_check_cmd jq
	_unlock_bw_persistent
	
	local item_json
	if ! _get_item_json "$item_name" item_json; then
		exit 1
	fi
	
	local field_value
	field_value=$(echo "$item_json" | jq -r --arg name "$field_name" '.fields[]? | select(.name == $name) | .value')
	
	if [[ -z "$field_value" ]] || [[ "$field_value" == "null" ]]; then
		lx output --error "Field '$field_name' not found in item '$item_name'"
		exit 1
	fi
	
	if [[ "$copy_mode" -eq 1 ]]; then
		_copy_to_clipboard "$field_value"
	else
		echo "$field_value"
	fi
}

# Handles 'set' command - add or update field.
function _cmd_set {
	local item_name="$1"
	local field_name="$2"
	local field_value="$3"
	local field_type="$4"
	local force_mode="$5"
	
	_check_cmd bw
	_check_cmd jq
	_unlock_bw_persistent
	
	if [[ -z "$field_name" ]]; then
		lx input --prompt "Field name:" @field_name
	fi
	
	if [[ -z "$field_name" ]]; then
		lx output --error "Field name is required."
		exit 1
	fi
	
	local item_json
	if ! _get_item_json "$item_name" item_json; then
		exit 1
	fi
	
	item_json=$(echo "$item_json" | jq 'if .fields == null then .fields = [] else . end')
	
	local item_id
	item_id=$(echo "$item_json" | jq -r '.id')
	
	local exists
	exists=$(echo "$item_json" | jq --arg name "$field_name" '[.fields[] | select(.name == $name)] | length')
	
	local new_json=""
	local action=""
	
	if [[ "$exists" -gt 0 ]]; then
		if [[ "$force_mode" -ne 1 ]]; then
			lx output --error "Field '$field_name' already exists. Use --force to overwrite."
			exit 1
		fi
		action="update"
	else
		action="add"
	fi
	
	if [[ -z "$field_value" ]]; then
		if [[ "$field_type" == "hidden" ]]; then
			lx input --prompt "Enter hidden value:" --password @field_value
		else
			lx input --prompt "Enter value:" @field_value
		fi
	fi
	
	local type_num=0
	case "$field_type" in
		hidden) type_num=1 ;;
		bool) type_num=2 ;;
		*) type_num=0 ;;
	esac
	
	if [[ "$action" == "add" ]]; then
		new_json=$(echo "$item_json" | jq \
			--arg name "$field_name" \
			--arg value "$field_value" \
			--argjson type "$type_num" \
			'.fields += [{"name": $name, "value": $value, "type": $type}]')
		lx output --info "Adding field '$field_name'..."
	else
		new_json=$(echo "$item_json" | jq \
			--arg name "$field_name" \
			--arg value "$field_value" \
			'(.fields[] | select(.name == $name).value) |= $value')
		lx output --info "Updating field '$field_name'..."
	fi
	
	if echo "$new_json" | bw encode | bw edit item "$item_id" > /dev/null; then
		lx output --ok "Successfully saved field '$field_name'."
	else
		lx output --error "Failed to save changes."
		exit 1
	fi
}

# Handles 'remove' command - delete field.
function _cmd_remove {
	local item_name="$1"
	local field_name="$2"
	
	if [[ -z "$field_name" ]]; then
		lx output --error "Field name is required for remove."
		exit 1
	fi
	
	_check_cmd bw
	_check_cmd jq
	_unlock_bw_persistent
	
	local item_json
	if ! _get_item_json "$item_name" item_json; then
		exit 1
	fi
	
	local exists
	exists=$(echo "$item_json" | jq --arg name "$field_name" '[.fields[] | select(.name == $name)] | length')
	
	if [[ "$exists" -eq 0 ]]; then
		lx output --error "Field '$field_name' does not exist."
		exit 1
	fi
	
	local item_id
	item_id=$(echo "$item_json" | jq -r '.id')
	
	local new_json
	new_json=$(echo "$item_json" | jq --arg name "$field_name" 'del(.fields[] | select(.name == $name))')
	
	if echo "$new_json" | bw encode | bw edit item "$item_id" > /dev/null; then
		lx output --ok "Successfully removed field '$field_name'."
	else
		lx output --error "Failed to save changes."
		exit 1
	fi
}

# Handles 'list' command - show all items.
function _cmd_list {
	_unlock_rbw
	
	local output
	if ! output=$(rbw list 2>/dev/null); then
		lx output --error "Failed to list items."
		exit 1
	fi
	
	echo "$output"
}

# ==============================================================================
# --- Entry Point ---
# ==============================================================================

function extension_start {
	_check_cmd rbw
	_check_cmd pass
	
	local command="${ARG_COMMAND:-}"
	local item="${ARG_ITEM:-}"
	local field="${ARG_FIELD:-}"
	local value="${ARG_VALUE:-}"
	local type="${ARG_TYPE:-text}"
	local copy="${ARG_COPY:-0}"
	local force="${ARG_FORCE:-0}"
	
	if [[ -z "$command" ]]; then
		lx output --error "No command specified. Use: get, set, remove, list"
		exit 1
	fi
	
	case "$command" in
		get)
			if [[ -z "$item" ]]; then
				lx input --prompt "Item name:" @item
			fi
			if [[ -z "$item" ]]; then
				lx output --error "Item name is required."
				exit 1
			fi
			_cmd_get "$item" "$field" "$copy"
			;;
		set)
			if [[ -z "$item" ]]; then
				lx input --prompt "Item name:" @item
			fi
			if [[ -z "$item" ]]; then
				lx output --error "Item name is required."
				exit 1
			fi
			_cmd_set "$item" "$field" "$value" "$type" "$force"
			;;
		remove)
			if [[ -z "$item" ]]; then
				lx input --prompt "Item name:" @item
			fi
			if [[ -z "$item" ]]; then
				lx output --error "Item name is required."
				exit 1
			fi
			_cmd_remove "$item" "$field"
			;;
		list)
			_cmd_list
			;;
		*)
			lx output --error "Unknown command: $command"
			lx output --info "Available commands: get, set, remove, list"
			exit 1
			;;
	esac
}

#!/bin/bash

# ==============================================================================
# --- Extension Global Library ---
# Contains global helper functions utilized by key submodules.
# ==============================================================================

declare -r CMD_PASS_VAULTWARDEN="vaultwarden"
declare -r BW_EMAIL="mycont79-homenetwork@yahoo.com"
# Nutze das projektweite state/ Verzeichnis
declare -r STATE_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/../../" && pwd)/state"
declare -r SESSION_FILE="${STATE_DIR}/bw-session"

function _check_cmd {
	local cmd="$1"
	if ! command -v "$cmd" &> /dev/null; then
		lx output --error "Error: $cmd is not installed."
		exit 1
	fi
}

function _copy_to_clipboard {
	local text="$1"
	
	if command -v wl-copy &> /dev/null; then
		echo -n "$text" | wl-copy
		lx output --ok "Copied to clipboard (wayland)"
	elif command -v xclip &> /dev/null; then
		echo -n "$text" | xclip -selection clipboard
		lx output --ok "Copied to clipboard (xclip)"
	elif command -v xsel &> /dev/null; then
		echo -n "$text" | xsel --clipboard --input
		lx output --ok "Copied to clipboard (xsel)"
	else
		lx output --warn "No clipboard tool found. Printing instead:"
		echo "$text"
	fi
}

function _unlock_rbw {
	if ! rbw unlocked &> /dev/null; then
		lx output --info "Unlocking rbw... (Please check for GPG pinentry popup if required)"
		
		local vault_pass
		vault_pass=$(pass show "${CMD_PASS_VAULTWARDEN}" | head -n 1)
		
		if [[ -z "$vault_pass" ]]; then
			lx output --error "Failed to retrieve vault password from pass."
			exit 1
		fi

		expect <<EOF &> /dev/null
log_user 0
spawn rbw unlock
expect "Master Password:"
send "${vault_pass}\r"
expect eof
EOF

		rbw sync &> /dev/null
		lx output --ok "rbw unlocked successfully."
	fi
}

function _unlock_bw_persistent {
	mkdir -p "$STATE_DIR"
	
	if [[ -f "$SESSION_FILE" ]]; then
		export BW_SESSION=$(cat "$SESSION_FILE")
	fi

	if bw status 2>/dev/null | jq -e '.status == "unlocked"' >/dev/null; then
		return 0
	fi

	lx output --info "Bitwarden locked. Unlocking... (Please check for GPG pinentry popup)"

	local vault_pass new_session
	vault_pass=$(pass show "${CMD_PASS_VAULTWARDEN}" | head -n 1)
	
	if [[ -z "$vault_pass" ]]; then
		lx output --error "Failed to retrieve vault password."
		exit 1
	fi

	new_session=$(bw unlock --raw --passwordenv VAULT_PASS 2>/dev/null)
	
	if [[ -z "$new_session" ]]; then
		bw logout &>/dev/null
		new_session=$(bw login "$BW_EMAIL" --passwordenv VAULT_PASS --raw 2>/dev/null)
	fi

	unset VAULT_PASS
	
	if [[ -n "$new_session" ]]; then
		echo "$new_session" > "$SESSION_FILE"
		chmod 600 "$SESSION_FILE"
		export BW_SESSION="$new_session"
		lx output --ok "Bitwarden unlocked."
	else
		lx output --error "Failed to unlock Bitwarden."
		exit 1
	fi
}

function _get_item_json {
	local item_name="$1"
	local output_var="$2"
	local item_json
	
	if item_json=$(bw get item "$item_name" 2>/dev/null); then
		eval "$output_var='$item_json'"
		return 0
	fi
	
	local search_json
	if ! search_json=$(bw list items --search "$item_name" 2>/dev/null); then
		lx output --error "Item '$item_name' not found."
		return 1
	fi
	
	search_json=$(echo "$search_json" | jq --arg term "$item_name" '[.[] | select(.name | test($term; "i"))]')
	local count
	count=$(echo "$search_json" | jq 'length')
	
	if [[ "$count" -eq 0 ]]; then
		lx output --error "Item '$item_name' not found."
		return 1
	elif [[ "$count" -eq 1 ]]; then
		item_json=$(echo "$search_json" | jq '.[0]')
		eval "$output_var='$item_json'"
		return 0
	else
		if command -v fzf &> /dev/null; then
			local selection
			selection=$(echo "$search_json" | jq -r '.[] | "\(.name) [\(.login.username // "no-user")] (\(.id))"' | fzf --prompt="Select item: ")
			if [[ -n "$selection" ]]; then
				local id
				id=$(echo "$selection" | sed 's/.*(\(.*\))/\1/')
				if item_json=$(bw get item "$id" 2>/dev/null); then
					eval "$output_var='$item_json'"
					return 0
				fi
			fi
		fi
		lx output --error "Multiple items found. Use exact name or install fzf."
		return 1
	fi
}

#!/bin/bash

# Prüfen ob rbw entsperrt ist, andernfalls per 'pass' entsperren.
# Das vermeidet ein Hängen während Fish Autocomplete. GPG wird stattdessen
# ein Pinentry-Popup anzeigen, das die Shell nicht blockiert.
if ! rbw unlocked &> /dev/null; then
    vault_pass=$(pass show vaultwarden | head -n 1)
    if [[ -n "$vault_pass" ]]; then
        expect -c "

function extension_start {
	source "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/../extension_global.sh"
	
	_check_cmd bw
	_check_cmd jq

	_unlock_bw_persistent
	
	local item="${ARG_ITEM:-}"
	local field="${ARG_FIELD:-}"
	local value="${ARG_VALUE:-}"
	local type="${ARG_TYPE:-text}"
	local force="${ARG_FORCE:-0}"
	
	if [[ -z "$item" ]]; then
		lx input --prompt "Item name:" @item
	fi
	if [[ -z "$item" ]]; then
		lx output --error "Item name is required."
		exit 1
	fi
	
	if [[ -z "$field" ]]; then
		lx input --prompt "Field name:" @field
	fi
	if [[ -z "$field" ]]; then
		lx output --error "Field name is required."
		exit 1
	fi
	
	local item_json
	if ! _get_item_json "$item" item_json; then
		exit 1
	fi
	
	item_json=$(echo "$item_json" | jq 'if .fields == null then .fields = [] else . end')
	
	local item_id
	item_id=$(echo "$item_json" | jq -r '.id')
	
	local exists
	exists=$(echo "$item_json" | jq --arg name "$field" '[.fields[] | select(.name == $name)] | length')
	
	local new_json=""
	local action=""
	
	if [[ "$exists" -gt 0 ]]; then
		if [[ "$force" -ne 1 ]]; then
			lx output --error "Field '$field' already exists. Use --force to overwrite."
			exit 1
		fi
		action="update"
	else
		action="add"
	fi
	
	if [[ -z "$value" ]]; then
		if [[ "$type" == "hidden" ]]; then
			lx input --prompt "Enter hidden value:" --password @value
		else
			lx input --prompt "Enter value:" @value
		fi
	fi
	
	local type_num=0
	case "$type" in
		hidden) type_num=1 ;;
		bool) type_num=2 ;;
		*) type_num=0 ;;
	esac
	
	if [[ "$action" == "add" ]]; then
		new_json=$(echo "$item_json" | jq \
			--arg name "$field" \
			--arg value "$value" \
			--argjson type "$type_num" \
			'.fields += [{"name": $name, "value": $value, "type": $type}]')
		lx output --info "Adding field '$field'..."
	else
		new_json=$(echo "$item_json" | jq \
			--arg name "$field" \
			--arg value "$value" \
			'(.fields[] | select(.name == $name).value) |= $value')
		lx output --info "Updating field '$field'..."
	fi
	
	if echo "$new_json" | bw encode | bw edit item "$item_id" > /dev/null; then
		lx output --ok "Successfully saved field '$field'."
	else
		lx output --error "Failed to save changes."
		exit 1
	fi
}

CMD_PASS_VAULTWARDEN="vaultwarden"
BW_EMAIL="mycont79-homenetwork@yahoo.com"

#!/bin/bash

# ==============================================================================
# --- Extension Global Library ---
# Contains global helper functions utilized by key submodules.
# ==============================================================================

# Nutze das projektweite state/ Verzeichnis
STATE_DIR="${STATE_DIR:-$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/../../" && pwd)/state}"
SESSION_FILE="${STATE_DIR}/bw-session"
CONFIG_FILE="${STATE_DIR}/config"

# Lade Konfiguration aus dem state-Verzeichnis, falls vorhanden
if [[ -f "$CONFIG_FILE" ]]; then
	source "$CONFIG_FILE"
fi

# Fallbacks, falls Variablen nicht in der Config definiert wurden
CMD_PASS_VAULTWARDEN="${CMD_PASS_VAULTWARDEN:-vaultwarden}"
BW_EMAIL="${BW_EMAIL:-mycont79-homenetwork@yahoo.com}"

function _check_cmd {
	local cmd="$1"
	if ! command -v "$cmd" &> /dev/null; then
		lx output --error "Error: $cmd is not installed."
		exit 1
	fi
}

function _copy_to_clipboard {
	local text="$1"
	
	if command -v wl-copy &> /dev/null; then
		echo -n "$text" | wl-copy
		lx output --ok "Copied to clipboard (wayland)"
	elif command -v xclip &> /dev/null; then
		echo -n "$text" | xclip -selection clipboard
		lx output --ok "Copied to clipboard (xclip)"
	elif command -v xsel &> /dev/null; then
		echo -n "$text" | xsel --clipboard --input
		lx output --ok "Copied to clipboard (xsel)"
	else
		lx output --warn "No clipboard tool found. Printing instead:"
		echo "$text"
	fi
}

function _unlock_rbw {
	if ! rbw unlocked &> /dev/null; then
		lx output --info "Unlocking rbw... (Please check for GPG pinentry popup if required)"
		
		local vault_pass
		vault_pass=$(pass show "${CMD_PASS_VAULTWARDEN}" | head -n 1)
		
		if [[ -z "$vault_pass" ]]; then
			lx output --error "Failed to retrieve vault password from pass."
			exit 1
		fi

		expect <<EOF &> /dev/null
log_user 0
spawn rbw unlock
expect "Master Password:"
send "${vault_pass}\r"
expect eof
EOF

		rbw sync &> /dev/null
		lx output --ok "rbw unlocked successfully."
	fi
}

function _unlock_bw_persistent {
	mkdir -p "$STATE_DIR"
	
	if [[ -f "$SESSION_FILE" ]]; then
		export BW_SESSION=$(cat "$SESSION_FILE")
	fi

	if bw status 2>/dev/null | jq -e '.status == "unlocked"' >/dev/null; then
		return 0
	fi

	lx output --info "Bitwarden locked. Unlocking... (Please check for GPG pinentry popup)"

	local vault_pass new_session
	vault_pass=$(pass show "${CMD_PASS_VAULTWARDEN}" | head -n 1)
	
	if [[ -z "$vault_pass" ]]; then
		lx output --error "Failed to retrieve vault password."
		exit 1
	fi

	new_session=$(bw unlock --raw --passwordenv VAULT_PASS 2>/dev/null)
	
	if [[ -z "$new_session" ]]; then
		bw logout &>/dev/null
		new_session=$(bw login "$BW_EMAIL" --passwordenv VAULT_PASS --raw 2>/dev/null)
	fi

	unset VAULT_PASS
	
	if [[ -n "$new_session" ]]; then
		echo "$new_session" > "$SESSION_FILE"
		chmod 600 "$SESSION_FILE"
		export BW_SESSION="$new_session"
		lx output --ok "Bitwarden unlocked."
	else
		lx output --error "Failed to unlock Bitwarden."
		exit 1
	fi
}

function _get_item_json {
	local item_name="$1"
	local output_var="$2"
	local item_json
	
	if item_json=$(bw get item "$item_name" 2>/dev/null); then
		eval "$output_var='$item_json'"
		return 0
	fi
	
	local search_json
	if ! search_json=$(bw list items --search "$item_name" 2>/dev/null); then
		lx output --error "Item '$item_name' not found."
		return 1
	fi
	
	search_json=$(echo "$search_json" | jq --arg term "$item_name" '[.[] | select(.name | test($term; "i"))]')
	local count
	count=$(echo "$search_json" | jq 'length')
	
	if [[ "$count" -eq 0 ]]; then
		lx output --error "Item '$item_name' not found."
		return 1
	elif [[ "$count" -eq 1 ]]; then
		item_json=$(echo "$search_json" | jq '.[0]')
		eval "$output_var='$item_json'"
		return 0
	else
		if command -v fzf &> /dev/null; then
			local selection
			selection=$(echo "$search_json" | jq -r '.[] | "\(.name) [\(.login.username // "no-user")] (\(.id))"' | fzf --prompt="Select item: ")
			if [[ -n "$selection" ]]; then
				local id

#!/bin/bash

# ==============================================================================
# --- Extension Global Library ---
# Contains global helper functions utilized by key submodules.
# ==============================================================================

# Das Framework (lpex) sourced die Datei ~/.local/state/lpex/data/key/config.conf 
# automatisch, bevor diese Scripte aufgerufen werden.
# Wir setzen hier nur Fallbacks, falls die Variablen (noch) leer sind.
CMD_PASS_VAULTWARDEN="${CMD_PASS_VAULTWARDEN:-vaultwarden}"
BW_EMAIL="${BW_EMAIL:-mycont79-homenetwork@yahoo.com}"

# Daten-Verzeichnis für diese Extension (wird von lpex standardmäßig genutzt)
declare EXT_DATA_DIR="$HOME/.local/state/lpex/data/key"
declare SESSION_FILE="${EXT_DATA_DIR}/bw-session"

function _check_cmd {
	local cmd="$1"
	if ! command -v "$cmd" &> /dev/null; then
		lx output --error "Error: $cmd is not installed."
		exit 1
	fi
}

function _copy_to_clipboard {
	local text="$1"
	
	if command -v wl-copy &> /dev/null; then
		echo -n "$text" | wl-copy
		lx output --ok "Copied to clipboard (wayland)"
	elif command -v xclip &> /dev/null; then
		echo -n "$text" | xclip -selection clipboard
		lx output --ok "Copied to clipboard (xclip)"
	elif command -v xsel &> /dev/null; then
		echo -n "$text" | xsel --clipboard --input
		lx output --ok "Copied to clipboard (xsel)"
	else
		lx output --warn "No clipboard tool found. Printing instead:"
		echo "$text"
	fi
}

function _unlock_rbw {
	if ! rbw unlocked &> /dev/null; then
		lx output --info "Unlocking rbw... (Requesting GPG Pinentry)"
		
		# WICHTIG: Damit GPG weiß, an welches Terminal es das Popup/Pinentry
		# schicken soll, muss GPG_TTY explizit gesetzt sein. Ansonsten 
		# hängt sich `pass show` auf oder liefert einen Fehler.
		export GPG_TTY=$(tty)
		
		local vault_pass
		if ! vault_pass=$(pass show "${CMD_PASS_VAULTWARDEN}" | head -n 1); then
			lx output --error "Failed to retrieve vault password from pass."
			exit 1
		fi
		
		if [[ -z "$vault_pass" ]]; then
			lx output --error "Pass returned an empty password for '${CMD_PASS_VAULTWARDEN}'."
			exit 1
		fi

		expect <<EOF &> /dev/null
log_user 0
spawn rbw unlock
expect "Master Password:"
send "${vault_pass}\r"
expect eof
EOF

		# Tatsächlichen Unlock-Status überprüfen
		if ! rbw unlocked &> /dev/null; then
			lx output --error "Failed to unlock rbw. Incorrect master password?"
			exit 1
		fi

		rbw sync &> /dev/null
		lx output --ok "rbw unlocked successfully."
	fi
}

function _unlock_bw_persistent {
	mkdir -p "$EXT_DATA_DIR"
	
	if [[ -f "$SESSION_FILE" ]]; then
		export BW_SESSION=$(cat "$SESSION_FILE")
	fi

	if bw status 2>/dev/null | jq -e '.status == "unlocked"' >/dev/null; then
		return 0
	fi

	lx output --info "Bitwarden locked. Unlocking... (Requesting GPG Pinentry)"

	export GPG_TTY=$(tty)
	local vault_pass new_session
	
	if ! vault_pass=$(pass show "${CMD_PASS_VAULTWARDEN}" | head -n 1); then
		lx output --error "Failed to retrieve vault password from pass."
		exit 1
	fi
	
	if [[ -z "$vault_pass" ]]; then
		lx output --error "Pass returned an empty password."
		exit 1
	fi

	new_session=$(bw unlock --raw --passwordenv VAULT_PASS 2>/dev/null)
	
	if [[ -z "$new_session" ]]; then
		bw logout &>/dev/null
		new_session=$(bw login "$BW_EMAIL" --passwordenv VAULT_PASS --raw 2>/dev/null)
	fi

	unset VAULT_PASS
	
	if [[ -n "$new_session" ]]; then
		echo "$new_session" > "$SESSION_FILE"
		chmod 600 "$SESSION_FILE"
		export BW_SESSION="$new_session"
		lx output --ok "Bitwarden unlocked."
	else
		lx output --error "Failed to unlock Bitwarden."
		exit 1
	fi
}

function _get_item_json {
	local item_name="$1"
	local output_var="$2"
	local item_json
	
	if item_json=$(bw get item "$item_name" 2>/dev/null); then
		eval "$output_var='$item_json'"
		return 0
	fi
	
	local search_json
	if ! search_json=$(bw list items --search "$item_name" 2>/dev/null); then
		lx output --error "Item '$item_name' not found."
		return 1
	fi
	
	search_json=$(echo "$search_json" | jq --arg term "$item_name" '[.[] | select(.name | test($term; "i"))]')
	local count
	count=$(echo "$search_json" | jq 'length')
	
	if [[ "$count" -eq 0 ]]; then
		lx output --error "Item '$item_name' not found."
		return 1
	elif [[ "$count" -eq 1 ]]; then
		item_json=$(echo "$search_json" | jq '.[0]')
		eval "$output_var='$item_json'"
		return 0
	else
		if command -v fzf &> /dev/null; then
			local selection
			selection=$(echo "$search_json" | jq -r '.[] | "\(.name) [\(.login.username // "no-user")] (\(.id))"' | fzf --prompt="Select item: ")
			if [[ -n "$selection" ]]; then
				local id
				id=$(echo "$selection" | sed 's/.*(\(.*\))/\1/')
				if item_json=$(bw get item "$id" 2>/dev/null); then
					eval "$output_var='$item_json'"
					return 0
				fi
			fi
		fi
		lx output --error "Multiple items found. Use exact name or install fzf."
		return 1
	fi
}

#!/bin/bash

# ==============================================================================
# --- Unlock Helper & Global Functions ---
# Wird von 'key' und 'key-field' genutzt.
# ==============================================================================

# Einheitliches Datenverzeichnis für beide Extensions
declare -r KEY_DATA_DIR="$HOME/.local/state/lpex/data/key"
declare -r CONFIG_FILE="$KEY_DATA_DIR/config.conf"
declare -r SESSION_FILE="$KEY_DATA_DIR/bw-session"

function _check_cmd {
	local cmd="$1"
	if ! command -v "$cmd" &> /dev/null; then
		lx output --error "Error: $cmd is not installed."
		exit 1
	fi
}

function _unlock_both {
	_check_cmd rbw
	_check_cmd pass

	# Lese Config aus, falls vorhanden
	local cmd_pass="vaultwarden"
	local bw_email="mycont79-homenetwork@yahoo.com"
	
	if [[ -f "$CONFIG_FILE" ]]; then
		source "$CONFIG_FILE"
		cmd_pass="${CMD_PASS_VAULTWARDEN:-$cmd_pass}"
		bw_email="${BW_EMAIL:-$bw_email}"
	fi

	local rbw_locked=0
	local bw_locked=0
	
	if ! rbw unlocked &> /dev/null; then
		rbw_locked=1
	fi
	
	if command -v bw &> /dev/null; then
		if [[ -f "$SESSION_FILE" ]]; then
			export BW_SESSION=$(cat "$SESSION_FILE")
		fi
		if ! bw status 2>/dev/null | jq -e '.status == "unlocked"' >/dev/null; then
			bw_locked=1
		fi
	fi

	# Nur entsperren, wenn mindestens eins gesperrt ist
	if [[ "$rbw_locked" -eq 1 ]] || [[ "$bw_locked" -eq 1 ]]; then
		lx output --info "Bitwarden locked. Unlocking... (Requesting GPG Pinentry)"
		
		# Essenziell für GPG Pinentry in Subshells
		export GPG_TTY=$(tty)
		
		local vault_pass
		if ! vault_pass=$(pass show "$cmd_pass" 2>/dev/null | head -n 1); then
			lx output --error "Failed to retrieve vault password from pass for '$cmd_pass'."
			exit 1
		fi
		
		if [[ -z "$vault_pass" ]]; then
			lx output --error "Pass returned an empty password."
			exit 1
		fi

		export VAULT_PASS="$vault_pass"

		# RBW Unlock
		if [[ "$rbw_locked" -eq 1 ]]; then
			expect <<EOF &> /dev/null
log_user 0
spawn rbw unlock
expect "Master Password:"
send "${vault_pass}\r"
expect eof
EOF
			rbw sync &> /dev/null
			
			if ! rbw unlocked &> /dev/null; then
				lx output --error "Failed to unlock rbw."
				exit 1
			fi
			lx output --ok "rbw unlocked successfully."
		fi

		# BW Unlock
		if [[ "$bw_locked" -eq 1 ]]; then
			local new_session
			new_session=$(bw unlock --raw --passwordenv VAULT_PASS 2>/dev/null || true)
			
			if [[ -z "$new_session" ]]; then
				bw logout &>/dev/null
				new_session=$(bw login "$bw_email" --passwordenv VAULT_PASS --raw 2>/dev/null || true)
			fi
			
			if [[ -n "$new_session" ]]; then
				mkdir -p "$KEY_DATA_DIR"
				echo "$new_session" > "$SESSION_FILE"
				chmod 600 "$SESSION_FILE"
				export BW_SESSION="$new_session"
				lx output --ok "bw unlocked successfully."
			else
				lx output --warn "Failed to unlock bw. Custom fields might not work."
			fi
		fi
		
		unset VAULT_PASS
	fi
}

# Holt Item JSON für bw (wird in key-field genutzt)
function _get_item_json {
	local item_name="$1"
	local output_var="$2"
	local item_json
	
	if item_json=$(bw get item "$item_name" 2>/dev/null); then
		eval "$output_var='$item_json'"
		return 0
	fi
	
	local search_json
	if ! search_json=$(bw list items --search "$item_name" 2>/dev/null); then
		lx output --error "Item '$item_name' not found."
		return 1
	fi
	
	search_json=$(echo "$search_json" | jq --arg term "$item_name" '[.[] | select(.name | test($term; "i"))]')
	local count
	count=$(echo "$search_json" | jq 'length')
	
	if [[ "$count" -eq 0 ]]; then
		lx output --error "Item '$item_name' not found."
		return 1
	elif [[ "$count" -eq 1 ]]; then
		item_json=$(echo "$search_json" | jq '.[0]')
		eval "$output_var='$item_json'"
		return 0
	else
		if command -v fzf &> /dev/null; then
			local selection
			selection=$(echo "$search_json" | jq -r '.[] | "\(.name) [\(.login.username // "no-user")] (\(.id))"' | fzf --prompt="Select item: ")
			if [[ -n "$selection" ]]; then
				local id
				id=$(echo "$selection" | sed 's/.*(\(.*\))/\1/')
				if item_json=$(bw get item "$id" 2>/dev/null); then
					eval "$output_var='$item_json'"
					return 0
				fi
			fi
		fi
		lx output --error "Multiple items found. Use exact name or install fzf."
		return 1
	fi
}

#!/bin/bash

function arguments {
	arg_value @item \
		--description "Bitwarden item name" \
		--option-cmd "rbw list 2>/dev/null || echo ''"

	arg_value @field \
		--description "Custom field name"

	arg_value @value \
		--description "Value to set"

	arg_value @type \
		--description "Field type: text, hidden (password), or bool" \
		--option "text # Plain text field" \
		--option "hidden # Hidden/password field" \
		--option "bool # Boolean field"

	arg_flag @force \
		--description "Force overwrite if field already exists"
}

#!/bin/bash

function extension_start {
	# Wir nutzen die Unlock-Logik aus der main 'key' Extension
	source "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/../../key/unlock.sh"
	
	_check_cmd bw
	_check_cmd jq
	_check_cmd pass
	
	# Stellt sicher, dass BW (und RBW) entsperrt sind
	_unlock_both
	
	local item="${ARG_ITEM:-}"
	local field="${ARG_FIELD:-}"
	local value="${ARG_VALUE:-}"
	local type="${ARG_TYPE:-text}"
	local force="${ARG_FORCE:-0}"
	
	if [[ -z "$item" ]]; then
		lx input --prompt "Item name:" @item
	fi
	if [[ -z "$item" ]]; then
		lx output --error "Item name is required."
		exit 1
	fi
	
	if [[ -z "$field" ]]; then
		lx input --prompt "Field name:" @field
	fi
	if [[ -z "$field" ]]; then
		lx output --error "Field name is required."
		exit 1
	fi
	
	local item_json
	if ! _get_item_json "$item" item_json; then
		exit 1
	fi
	
	item_json=$(echo "$item_json" | jq 'if .fields == null then .fields = [] else . end')
	
	local item_id
	item_id=$(echo "$item_json" | jq -r '.id')
	
	local exists
	exists=$(echo "$item_json" | jq --arg name "$field" '[.fields[] | select(.name == $name)] | length')
	
	local new_json=""
	local action=""
	
	if [[ "$exists" -gt 0 ]]; then
		if [[ "$force" -ne 1 ]]; then
			lx output --error "Field '$field' already exists. Use --force to overwrite."
			exit 1
		fi
		action="update"
	else
		action="add"
	fi
	
	if [[ -z "$value" ]]; then
		if [[ "$type" == "hidden" ]]; then
			lx input --prompt "Enter hidden value:" --password @value
		else
			lx input --prompt "Enter value:" @value
		fi
	fi
	
	local type_num=0
	case "$type" in
		hidden) type_num=1 ;;
		bool) type_num=2 ;;
		*) type_num=0 ;;
	esac
	
	if [[ "$action" == "add" ]]; then
		new_json=$(echo "$item_json" | jq \
			--arg name "$field" \
			--arg value "$value" \
			--argjson type "$type_num" \
			'.fields += [{"name": $name, "value": $value, "type": $type}]')
		lx output --info "Adding field '$field'..."
	else
		new_json=$(echo "$item_json" | jq \
			--arg name "$field" \
			--arg value "$value" \
			'(.fields[] | select(.name == $name).value) |= $value')
		lx output --info "Updating field '$field'..."
	fi
	
	if echo "$new_json" | bw encode | bw edit item "$item_id" > /dev/null; then
		lx output --ok "Successfully saved field '$field'."
	else
		lx output --error "Failed to save changes."
		exit 1
	fi
}

#!/bin/bash

function extension_start {
	source "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/../../key/unlock.sh"
	
	_check_cmd bw
	_check_cmd jq
	_check_cmd pass
	
	_unlock_both
	
	local item="${ARG_ITEM:-}"
	local field="${ARG_FIELD:-}"
	
	if [[ -z "$item" ]]; then
		lx input --prompt "Item name:" @item
	fi
	if [[ -z "$item" ]]; then
		lx output --error "Item name is required."
		exit 1
	fi
	
	if [[ -z "$field" ]]; then
		lx input --prompt "Field name to remove:" @field
	fi
	if [[ -z "$field" ]]; then
		lx output --error "Field name is required for remove."
		exit 1
	fi
	
	local item_json
	if ! _get_item_json "$item" item_json; then
		exit 1
	fi
	
	local exists
	exists=$(echo "$item_json" | jq --arg name "$field" '[.fields[] | select(.name == $name)] | length')
	
	if [[ "$exists" -eq 0 ]]; then
		lx output --error "Field '$field' does not exist."
		exit 1
	fi
	
	local item_id
	item_id=$(echo "$item_json" | jq -r '.id')
	
	local new_json
	new_json=$(echo "$item_json" | jq --arg name "$field" 'del(.fields[] | select(.name == $name))')

		lx output --ok "Successfully removed field '$field'."

#!/bin/bash

# ==============================================================================
# --- Shared Helper & Global Functions ---
# Wird von 'key' (nur rbw) und 'key-field' (bw) genutzt.
# ==============================================================================

# Einheitliches Datenverzeichnis für beide Extensions
declare -r KEY_DATA_DIR="$HOME/.local/state/lpex/data/key"
declare -r CONFIG_FILE="$KEY_DATA_DIR/config.conf"
declare -r SESSION_FILE="$KEY_DATA_DIR/bw-session"

function _check_cmd {
	local cmd="$1"
	if ! command -v "$cmd" &> /dev/null; then
		lx output --error "Error: $cmd is not installed."
		exit 1
	fi
}

function _get_master_password {
	local cmd_pass="vaultwarden"
	if [[ -f "$CONFIG_FILE" ]]; then
		source "$CONFIG_FILE"
		cmd_pass="${CMD_PASS_VAULTWARDEN:-$cmd_pass}"
	fi

	# Essenziell für GPG Pinentry in Subshells (Popup taucht auf)
	export GPG_TTY=$(tty)
	
	local vault_pass
	if ! vault_pass=$(pass show "$cmd_pass" 2>/dev/null | head -n 1); then
		# Fehlerausgabe auf stderr umleiten, damit Autocomplete nicht bricht
		echo "Failed to retrieve vault password from pass for '$cmd_pass'." >&2
		exit 1
	fi
	
	if [[ -z "$vault_pass" ]]; then
		echo "Pass returned an empty password." >&2
		exit 1
	fi
	
	echo "$vault_pass"
}

# Extrem schnelle Prüfung & Entsperrung für rbw (genutzt für key + Autocompletion)
function _unlock_rbw {
	# Dieser Check dauert nur wenige Millisekunden!
	if rbw unlocked &> /dev/null; then
		return 0
	fi

	# Wenn gesperrt, Passwort holen und entsperren
	local vault_pass
	vault_pass=$(_get_master_password)

	expect <<EOF &> /dev/null
log_user 0
spawn rbw unlock
expect "Master Password:"
send "${vault_pass}\r"
expect eof
EOF
	rbw sync &> /dev/null
}

# Prüft und entsperrt bw (genutzt für key-field).
# bw ist in der Regel langsam (NodeJS CLI + Status Check), daher rufen wir das nur auf,
# wenn wir wirklich Custom Fields ändern wollen.
function _unlock_bw {
	_check_cmd bw
	_check_cmd jq
	
	if [[ -f "$SESSION_FILE" ]]; then
		export BW_SESSION=$(cat "$SESSION_FILE")
	fi

	# Status check bei bw ist relativ langsam
	if bw status 2>/dev/null | jq -e '.status == "unlocked"' >/dev/null; then
		return 0
	fi

	lx output --info "Bitwarden locked. Unlocking... (Requesting GPG Pinentry)"

	local bw_email="mycont79-homenetwork@yahoo.com"
	if [[ -f "$CONFIG_FILE" ]]; then
		source "$CONFIG_FILE"
		bw_email="${BW_EMAIL:-$bw_email}"
	fi

	local vault_pass
	vault_pass=$(_get_master_password)
	export VAULT_PASS="$vault_pass"

	local new_session
	new_session=$(bw unlock --raw --passwordenv VAULT_PASS 2>/dev/null || true)
	
	if [[ -z "$new_session" ]]; then
		bw logout &>/dev/null
		new_session=$(bw login "$bw_email" --passwordenv VAULT_PASS --raw 2>/dev/null || true)
	fi
	
	unset VAULT_PASS

	if [[ -n "$new_session" ]]; then
		mkdir -p "$KEY_DATA_DIR"
		echo "$new_session" > "$SESSION_FILE"
		chmod 600 "$SESSION_FILE"
		export BW_SESSION="$new_session"
		lx output --ok "bw unlocked successfully."
	else
		lx output --error "Failed to unlock bw. Custom fields might not work."
		exit 1
	fi
}

# Holt Item JSON für bw (wird in key-field genutzt)
function _get_item_json {
	local item_name="$1"
	local output_var="$2"
	local item_json
	
	if item_json=$(bw get item "$item_name" 2>/dev/null); then
		eval "$output_var='$item_json'"
		return 0
	fi
	
	local search_json
	if ! search_json=$(bw list items --search "$item_name" 2>/dev/null); then
		lx output --error "Item '$item_name' not found."
		return 1
	fi
	
	search_json=$(echo "$search_json" | jq --arg term "$item_name" '[.[] | select(.name | test($term; "i"))]')
	local count
	count=$(echo "$search_json" | jq 'length')
	
	if [[ "$count" -eq 0 ]]; then
		lx output --error "Item '$item_name' not found."
		return 1
	elif [[ "$count" -eq 1 ]]; then
		item_json=$(echo "$search_json" | jq '.[0]')
		eval "$output_var='$item_json'"
		return 0
	else
		if command -v fzf &> /dev/null; then
			local selection
			selection=$(echo "$search_json" | jq -r '.[] | "\(.name) [\(.login.username // "no-user")] (\(.id))"' | fzf --prompt="Select item: ")
			if [[ -n "$selection" ]]; then
				local id
				id=$(echo "$selection" | sed 's/.*(\(.*\))/\1/')
				if item_json=$(bw get item "$id" 2>/dev/null); then
					eval "$output_var='$item_json'"
					return 0
				fi
			fi
		fi
		lx output --error "Multiple items found. Use exact name or install fzf."
		return 1
	fi
}

#!/bin/bash

function extension_start {
	source "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/../../key/shared.sh"
	
	# Da 'key-field' via 'bw' arbeitet und Custom Fields editiert,
	# entsperren wir hier explizit 'bw' (welches etwas träger ist).
	_unlock_bw
	
	local item="${ARG_ITEM:-}"
	local field="${ARG_FIELD:-}"
	local value="${ARG_VALUE:-}"
	local type="${ARG_TYPE:-text}"
	local force="${ARG_FORCE:-0}"
	
	if [[ -z "$item" ]]; then
		lx input --prompt "Item name:" @item
	fi
	if [[ -z "$item" ]]; then
		lx output --error "Item name is required."
		exit 1
	fi
	
	if [[ -z "$field" ]]; then
		lx input --prompt "Field name:" @field
	fi
	if [[ -z "$field" ]]; then
		lx output --error "Field name is required."
		exit 1
	fi
	
	local item_json
	if ! _get_item_json "$item" item_json; then
		exit 1
	fi
	
	item_json=$(echo "$item_json" | jq 'if .fields == null then .fields = [] else . end')
	
	local item_id
	item_id=$(echo "$item_json" | jq -r '.id')
	
	local exists
	exists=$(echo "$item_json" | jq --arg name "$field" '[.fields[] | select(.name == $name)] | length')
	
	local new_json=""
	local action=""
	
	if [[ "$exists" -gt 0 ]]; then
		if [[ "$force" -ne 1 ]]; then
			lx output --error "Field '$field' already exists. Use --force to overwrite."
			exit 1
		fi
		action="update"
	else
		action="add"
	fi
	
	if [[ -z "$value" ]]; then
		if [[ "$type" == "hidden" ]]; then
			lx input --prompt "Enter hidden value:" --password @value
		else
			lx input --prompt "Enter value:" @value
		fi
	fi
	
	local type_num=0
	case "$type" in
		hidden) type_num=1 ;;
		bool) type_num=2 ;;
		*) type_num=0 ;;
	esac
	
	if [[ "$action" == "add" ]]; then
		new_json=$(echo "$item_json" | jq \
			--arg name "$field" \
			--arg value "$value" \
			--argjson type "$type_num" \
			'.fields += [{"name": $name, "value": $value, "type": $type}]')
		lx output --info "Adding field '$field'..."
	else
		new_json=$(echo "$item_json" | jq \
			--arg name "$field" \
			--arg value "$value" \
			'(.fields[] | select(.name == $name).value) |= $value')
		lx output --info "Updating field '$field'..."
	fi
	
	if echo "$new_json" | bw encode | bw edit item "$item_id" > /dev/null; then
		lx output --ok "Successfully saved field '$field'."
	else
		lx output --error "Failed to save changes."
		exit 1
	fi
}

#!/bin/bash

function extension_start {
	source "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/../../key/shared.sh"
	
	# Entsperre bw (da Custom Fields über die offizielle Bitwarden CLI verwaltet werden)
	_unlock_bw
	
	local item="${ARG_ITEM:-}"
	local field="${ARG_FIELD:-}"
	
	if [[ -z "$item" ]]; then
		lx input --prompt "Item name:" @item
	fi
	if [[ -z "$item" ]]; then
		lx output --error "Item name is required."
		exit 1
	fi
	
	if [[ -z "$field" ]]; then
		lx input --prompt "Field name to remove:" @field
	fi
	if [[ -z "$field" ]]; then
		lx output --error "Field name is required for remove."
		exit 1
	fi
	
	local item_json
	if ! _get_item_json "$item" item_json; then
		exit 1
	fi
	
	local exists
	exists=$(echo "$item_json" | jq --arg name "$field" '[.fields[] | select(.name == $name)] | length')
	
	if [[ "$exists" -eq 0 ]]; then
		lx output --error "Field '$field' does not exist."
		exit 1
	fi
	
	local item_id
	item_id=$(echo "$item_json" | jq -r '.id')
	
	local new_json
	new_json=$(echo "$item_json" | jq --arg name "$field" 'del(.fields[] | select(.name == $name))')
	
	if echo "$new_json" | bw encode | bw edit item "$item_id" > /dev/null; then
		lx output --ok "Successfully removed field '$field'."
	else
		lx output --error "Failed to save changes."
		exit 1
	fi
}

# ==============================================================================
# --- Extension Global Library: Key ---
# Provides global helper functions utilized by the 'key' module.
# Deals exclusively with 'rbw' (Bitwarden Rust CLI) and unlocking via 'pass'.
# ==============================================================================

	if ! command -v "$cmd" &> /dev/null; then
		lx output --error "Error: $cmd is not installed."
		exit 1
	fi
}

function _get_master_password {
	# Ensure fallback in case config.conf was not loaded
	local cmd_pass="${CMD_PASS_VAULTWARDEN:-vaultwarden}"

	# Explicitly set GPG_TTY for pinentry popups when called from subshells

#!/bin/bash

# ==============================================================================
# --- Extension Global Library: Key Fields ---
# Provides global helper functions utilized by the 'key-fields' module.
# Deals exclusively with 'bw' (Official Bitwarden CLI) for custom fields.
# ==============================================================================

# Ensure the required session file is stored within the specific extension state
declare SESSION_FILE="$PATH_EXTENSION_DATA/bw-session"

# ==============================================================================
# --- Helper Functions ---
# ==============================================================================

function _check_cmd {
	local cmd="$1"
	if ! command -v "$cmd" &> /dev/null; then
		lx output --error "Error: $cmd is not installed."
		exit 1
	fi
}

function _get_master_password {
	local cmd_pass="${CMD_PASS_VAULTWARDEN:-vaultwarden}"

	export GPG_TTY=$(tty)
	
	local vault_pass
	if ! vault_pass=$(pass show "$cmd_pass" 2>/dev/null | head -n 1); then
		lx output --error "Failed to retrieve vault password from pass for '$cmd_pass'."
		exit 1
	fi
	
	if [[ -z "$vault_pass" ]]; then
		lx output --error "Pass returned an empty password."
		exit 1
	fi
	
	echo "$vault_pass"
}

# ==============================================================================
# --- Unlocking Logic ---
# ==============================================================================

function _unlock_bw {
	_check_cmd bw
	_check_cmd jq
	
	if [[ -f "$SESSION_FILE" ]]; then
		export BW_SESSION=$(cat "$SESSION_FILE")
	fi

	# bw status check is relatively slow, but needed for field modifications
	if bw status 2>/dev/null | jq -e '.status == "unlocked"' >/dev/null; then
		return 0
	fi

	lx output --info "Bitwarden locked. Unlocking... (Requesting GPG Pinentry)"

	local bw_email="${BW_EMAIL:-mycont79-homenetwork@yahoo.com}"
	
	local vault_pass
	vault_pass=$(_get_master_password)
	export VAULT_PASS="$vault_pass"

	local new_session
	new_session=$(bw unlock --raw --passwordenv VAULT_PASS 2>/dev/null || true)
	
	if [[ -z "$new_session" ]]; then
		bw logout &>/dev/null
		new_session=$(bw login "$bw_email" --passwordenv VAULT_PASS --raw 2>/dev/null || true)
	fi
	
	unset VAULT_PASS

	if [[ -n "$new_session" ]]; then
		mkdir -p "$PATH_EXTENSION_DATA"
		echo "$new_session" > "$SESSION_FILE"
		chmod 600 "$SESSION_FILE"
		export BW_SESSION="$new_session"
		lx output --ok "bw unlocked successfully."
	else
		lx output --error "Failed to unlock bw. Custom fields might not work."
		exit 1
	fi
}

# ==============================================================================
# --- Bitwarden Data Retrieval ---
# ==============================================================================

function _get_item_json {
	local item_name="$1"
	local output_var="$2"
	local item_json
	
	if item_json=$(bw get item "$item_name" 2>/dev/null); then
		eval "$output_var='$item_json'"
		return 0
	fi
	
	local search_json
	if ! search_json=$(bw list items --search "$item_name" 2>/dev/null); then
		lx output --error "Item '$item_name' not found."
		return 1
	fi
	
	search_json=$(echo "$search_json" | jq --arg term "$item_name" '[.[] | select(.name | test($term; "i"))]')
	local count
	count=$(echo "$search_json" | jq 'length')
	
	if [[ "$count" -eq 0 ]]; then
		lx output --error "Item '$item_name' not found."
		return 1
	elif [[ "$count" -eq 1 ]]; then
		item_json=$(echo "$search_json" | jq '.[0]')
		eval "$output_var='$item_json'"
		return 0
	else
		if command -v fzf &> /dev/null; then
			local selection
			selection=$(echo "$search_json" | jq -r '.[] | "\(.name) [\(.login.username // "no-user")] (\(.id))"' | fzf --prompt="Select item: ")
			if [[ -n "$selection" ]]; then
				local id
				id=$(echo "$selection" | sed 's/.*(\(.*\))/\1/')
				if item_json=$(bw get item "$id" 2>/dev/null); then
					eval "$output_var='$item_json'"
					return 0
				fi
			fi
		fi
		lx output --error "Multiple items found. Use exact name or install fzf."
		return 1
	fi
}

#!/bin/bash

# ==============================================================================
# --- Main Execution ---
# Module: key-fields set
# Adds or updates custom fields inside a Bitwarden item.
# ==============================================================================

function extension_start {
	_unlock_bw
	
	local item="${ARG_ITEM:-}"
	local field="${ARG_FIELD:-}"
	local value="${ARG_VALUE:-}"
	local type="${ARG_TYPE:-text}"
	local force="${ARG_FORCE:-0}"
	
	if [[ -z "$item" ]]; then
		lx input --prompt "Item name:" @item
	fi
	if [[ -z "$item" ]]; then
		lx output --error "Item name is required."
		exit 1
	fi
	
	if [[ -z "$field" ]]; then
		lx input --prompt "Field name:" @field
	fi
	if [[ -z "$field" ]]; then
		lx output --error "Field name is required."
		exit 1
	fi
	
	local item_json
	if ! _get_item_json "$item" item_json; then
		exit 1
	fi
	
	item_json=$(echo "$item_json" | jq 'if .fields == null then .fields = [] else . end')
	
	local item_id
	item_id=$(echo "$item_json" | jq -r '.id')
	
	local exists
	exists=$(echo "$item_json" | jq --arg name "$field" '[.fields[] | select(.name == $name)] | length')
	
	local new_json=""
	local action=""
	
	if [[ "$exists" -gt 0 ]]; then
		if [[ "$force" -ne 1 ]]; then
			lx output --error "Field '$field' already exists. Use --force to overwrite."
			exit 1
		fi
		action="update"
	else
		action="add"
	fi
	
	if [[ -z "$value" ]]; then
		if [[ "$type" == "hidden" ]]; then
			lx input --prompt "Enter hidden value:" --password @value
		else
			lx input --prompt "Enter value:" @value
		fi
	fi
	
	local type_num=0
	case "$type" in
		hidden) type_num=1 ;;
		bool) type_num=2 ;;
		*) type_num=0 ;;
	esac
	
	if [[ "$action" == "add" ]]; then
		new_json=$(echo "$item_json" | jq \
			--arg name "$field" \
			--arg value "$value" \
			--argjson type "$type_num" \
			'.fields += [{"name": $name, "value": $value, "type": $type}]')
		lx output --info "Adding field '$field'..."
	else
		new_json=$(echo "$item_json" | jq \
			--arg name "$field" \
			--arg value "$value" \
			'(.fields[] | select(.name == $name).value) |= $value')
		lx output --info "Updating field '$field'..."
	fi
	
	if echo "$new_json" | bw encode | bw edit item "$item_id" > /dev/null; then
		lx output --ok "Successfully saved field '$field'."
	else
		lx output --error "Failed to save changes."
		exit 1
	fi
}

#!/bin/bash

# ==============================================================================
# --- Main Execution ---
# Module: key-fields remove
# Removes a custom field from a Bitwarden item.
# ==============================================================================

function extension_start {
	_unlock_bw
	
	local item="${ARG_ITEM:-}"
	local field="${ARG_FIELD:-}"
	
	if [[ -z "$item" ]]; then
		lx input --prompt "Item name:" @item
	fi
	if [[ -z "$item" ]]; then
		lx output --error "Item name is required."
		exit 1
	fi
	
	if [[ -z "$field" ]]; then
		lx input --prompt "Field name to remove:" @field
	fi
	if [[ -z "$field" ]]; then
		lx output --error "Field name is required for remove."
		exit 1
	fi
	
	local item_json
	if ! _get_item_json "$item" item_json; then
		exit 1
	fi
	
	local exists
	exists=$(echo "$item_json" | jq --arg name "$field" '[.fields[] | select(.name == $name)] | length')
	
	if [[ "$exists" -eq 0 ]]; then
		lx output --error "Field '$field' does not exist."
		exit 1
	fi
	
	local item_id
	item_id=$(echo "$item_json" | jq -r '.id')
	
	local new_json
	new_json=$(echo "$item_json" | jq --arg name "$field" 'del(.fields[] | select(.name == $name))')
	
	if echo "$new_json" | bw encode | bw edit item "$item_id" > /dev/null; then
		lx output --ok "Successfully removed field '$field'."
	else
		lx output --error "Failed to save changes."
		exit 1
	fi
}

#!/bin/bash
# ==============================================================================
# --- Extension Global Library: Key ---
# Provides global helper functions utilized by the 'key' module.
# Deals exclusively with 'rbw' (Bitwarden Rust CLI) and unlocking via 'pass'.
# ==============================================================================

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Feature: Command Check
# Verifies that a required command exists before proceeding.
# Prevents execution errors if system dependencies are missing.
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
function _check_cmd() {
    local cmd="$1"
    
    # Check if the command is available in the current system PATH
    if ! command -v "$cmd" &> /dev/null; then
        output --error "Error: The required command '$cmd' is not installed."
        exit 1 # Hard exit to prevent any further script execution
    fi
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Feature: Master Password Retrieval
# Safely retrieves the vault password from 'pass' via GPG.
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
function _get_master_password() {
    # Set default password name, fallback to 'vaultwarden' if not explicitly set
    local cmd_pass="${CMD_PASS_VAULTWARDEN:-vaultwarden}"

    # Explicitly set GPG_TTY for pinentry popups when called from subshells.

# ==============================================================================
# --- Extension Global Library: Key Fields ---
# Provides global helper functions utilized by the 'key-fields' module.
# Manages 'rbw' for fast reading/listing and 'bw' for modifications.
# ==============================================================================

# Ensure the required session file is stored within the specific extension state path
declare SESSION_FILE="$PATH_EXTENSION_DATA/bw-session"

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Feature: Command Check
# Verifies that a required command exists before proceeding.
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
function _check_cmd() {
    local cmd="$1"
    
    # Check if command is available in the current PATH
    if ! command -v "$cmd" &> /dev/null; then
        output --error "Error: The required command '$cmd' is not installed."
        exit 1 # Hard exit to prevent failures
    fi
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Feature: Master Password Retrieval
# Safely retrieves the vault password from 'pass' via GPG.
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
function _get_master_password() {
    # Use fallback value if config variable is not set
    local cmd_pass="${CMD_PASS_VAULTWARDEN:-vaultwarden}"

    # Explicitly set GPG_TTY for pinentry popups when called from subshells
    export GPG_TTY=$(tty)
    
    local vault_pass
    # Retrieve the first line of the pass output
    if ! vault_pass=$(pass show "$cmd_pass" 2>/dev/null | head -n 1); then
        output --error "Failed to retrieve vault password from pass for '$cmd_pass'." >&2
        exit 1
    fi
    
    # Ensure the password is not empty
    if [[ -z "$vault_pass" ]]; then
        output --error "Pass returned an empty password." >&2
        exit 1
    fi
    
    # Return the retrieved password
    echo "$vault_pass"
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Feature: RBW Unlocking
# Rapidly checks if rbw is unlocked and unlocks it if necessary for fast reads.
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
function _unlock_rbw() {
    # Verify that rbw is installed
    _check_cmd rbw
    
    # Check if rbw is already unlocked
    if rbw unlocked &> /dev/null; then
        return 0
    fi

    local vault_pass
    vault_pass=$(_get_master_password)

    # Use expect to automate the unlocking process silently
    expect <<EOF &> /dev/null
log_user 0
spawn rbw unlock
expect "Master Password:"
send "${vault_pass}\r"
expect eof
EOF
    
    # Synchronize the vault to ensure the latest data is available
    rbw sync &> /dev/null
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Feature: BW Unlocking
# Checks and unlocks the official Bitwarden CLI (bw) for writing data.
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
function _unlock_bw() {
    # Verify that the required commands are installed
    _check_cmd bw
    _check_cmd jq
    
    # Load session token if available to avoid unnecessary unlocks
    if [[ -f "$SESSION_FILE" ]]; then
        export BW_SESSION=$(cat "$SESSION_FILE")
    fi

    # Check if bw is already unlocked
    # Note: 'bw status' is relatively slow, hence we only call it when modifying data
    if bw status 2>/dev/null | jq -e '.status == "unlocked"' >/dev/null; then
        return 0
    fi

    output --info "Bitwarden locked. Unlocking bw for modifications..."

    # Retrieve the Bitwarden email address from config or use fallback
    local bw_email="${BW_EMAIL:-mycont79-homenetwork@yahoo.com}"
    
    # Retrieve the master password
    local vault_pass
    vault_pass=$(_get_master_password)
    export VAULT_PASS="$vault_pass"

    # Attempt to unlock the vault using the password
    local new_session
    new_session=$(bw unlock --raw --passwordenv VAULT_PASS 2>/dev/null || true)
    
    # If unlocking failed, attempt to log in using email and password
    if [[ -z "$new_session" ]]; then
        bw logout &>/dev/null
        new_session=$(bw login "$bw_email" --passwordenv VAULT_PASS --raw 2>/dev/null || true)
    fi
    
    # Unset the password to avoid leaking it in the environment
    unset VAULT_PASS

    # Save the new session token if successful
    if [[ -n "$new_session" ]]; then
        # Ensure the target directory exists
        mkdir -p "$PATH_EXTENSION_DATA"
        # Write the session token to the file
        echo "$new_session" > "$SESSION_FILE"
        chmod 600 "$SESSION_FILE"
        
        # Export the new session variable
        export BW_SESSION="$new_session"
        output --ok "bw unlocked successfully."
    else
        output --error "Failed to unlock bw. Custom fields cannot be modified."
        exit 1
    fi
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Feature: Bitwarden Data Retrieval (bw)
# Retrieves the full JSON payload of an item for modification.
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
function _get_item_json() {
    local item_name="$1"
    local output_var="$2"
    local item_json
    
    # Attempt a direct exact match first to save time
    if item_json=$(bw get item "$item_name" 2>/dev/null); then
        eval "$output_var='$item_json'"
        return 0
    fi
    
    # Search for the item if the direct match fails
    local search_json
    if ! search_json=$(bw list items --search "$item_name" 2>/dev/null); then
        output --error "Item '$item_name' not found."
        return 1
    fi
    
    # Filter the exact name ignoring case
    search_json=$(echo "$search_json" | jq --arg term "$item_name" '[.[] | select(.name | test($term; "i"))]')
    
    # Determine the number of matching items
    local count
    count=$(echo "$search_json" | jq 'length')
    
    # Handle the search results appropriately
    if [[ "$count" -eq 0 ]]; then
        output --error "Item '$item_name' not found."
        return 1
    elif [[ "$count" -eq 1 ]]; then
        # Single match, select the first element and assign it
        item_json=$(echo "$search_json" | jq '.[0]')
        eval "$output_var='$item_json'"
        return 0
    else
        # Multiple matches, prompt user with fzf if available
        if command -v fzf &> /dev/null; then
            local selection
            selection=$(echo "$search_json" | jq -r '.[] | "\(.name) [\(.login.username // "no-user")] (\(.id))"' | fzf --prompt="Select item: ")
            
            # If the user made a selection, extract the ID and retrieve the specific item
            if [[ -n "$selection" ]]; then
                local id
                id=$(echo "$selection" | sed 's/.*(\(.*\))/\1/')
                if item_json=$(bw get item "$id" 2>/dev/null); then
                    eval "$output_var='$item_json'"
                    return 0
                fi
            fi
        fi
        output --error "Multiple items found. Use exact name or install fzf."
        return 1
    fi
}

# ==============================================================================

function arguments() {

    arg_value @item \
        --description "Bitwarden item name" \
        --option-cmd "rbw list 2>/dev/null || echo ''"

    # The custom field name or 'Notes' target
    arg_value @field \
        --description "Custom field name (or 'Notes' to edit notes)"

    arg_value @value \
        --description "Value to set (leave empty to prompt for deletion/input)"

    arg_value @type \
        --description "Field type: text, hidden (password), or bool" \
        --option "text # Plain text field" \

    arg_flag @force \
        --description "Force overwrite if field already exists"
}

#!/bin/bash
# ==============================================================================
# --- Main Execution ---
# Module: key-fields
# Interactively adds, updates, or removes custom fields and notes in Bitwarden.
# ==============================================================================

function extension_start() {
    # Ensure rbw is unlocked first since we use it for high-speed listing and filtering
    _unlock_rbw
    
    # Assign arguments to local variables for processing
    local item="${ARG_ITEM:-}"
    local field="${ARG_FIELD:-}"
    local value="${ARG_VALUE:-}"
    local type="${ARG_TYPE:-text}"
    local force="${ARG_FORCE:-0}"
    
    # If the item is missing, prompt the user interactively using fzf and rbw list
    if [[ -z "$item" ]]; then
        local item_list
        # Retrieve the list of items rapidly via the rbw cache
        item_list=$(rbw list 2>/dev/null)
        
        local selected_item
        # Display the list using the framework fzf prompt to let the user select
        if ! lx fzf @selected_item --list "$item_list" --prompt "Select Bitwarden Item: "; then
            output --error "Selection cancelled."
            exit 1
        fi
        
        # Assign the selected value to our item variable
        item="$selected_item"
    fi
    
    # Sanity check: Ensure item is successfully set
    if [[ -z "$item" ]]; then
        output --error "Item name is required."
        exit 1
    fi
    
    # If the specific field is missing, ask the user interactively
    if [[ -z "$field" ]]; then
        local field_list
        # Retrieve existing fields using rbw to evaluate choices
        field_list=$(rbw get --list-fields "$item" 2>/dev/null)
        
        # Prepend 'Notes' and '<New Field>' to the top of the dynamic list
        field_list="<New Field>\nNotes\n$field_list"
        
        local selected_field
        # Prompt the user to select an existing field, Notes, or to create a new one
        if ! lx fzf @selected_field --list "$field_list" --prompt "Select Field (or Notes): "; then
            output --error "Selection cancelled."
            exit 1
        fi
        
        # Handle the custom choice to add an entirely new field
        if [[ "$selected_field" == "<New Field>" ]]; then
            # Use framework input to securely ask for the new field name
            if ! lx input --prompt "Enter new field name:" @field; then
                output --error "Input cancelled."
                exit 1
            fi
        else
            # Otherwise, use the user's explicit selection
            field="$selected_field"
        fi
    fi
    
    # Sanity check: Ensure field is finally set
    if [[ -z "$field" ]]; then
        output --error "Field name is required."
        exit 1
    fi

    # We are about to modify data, so we must explicitly unlock the slower bw CLI
    _unlock_bw
    
    # Fetch the full JSON structure of the item via bw for deep manipulation
    local item_json
    if ! _get_item_json "$item" item_json; then
        exit 1
    fi
    
    # Ensure the .fields array exists in the JSON structure before any modification
    item_json=$(echo "$item_json" | jq 'if .fields == null then .fields = [] else . end')
    
    # Extract the unique ID of the item for the final save operation
    local item_id
    item_id=$(echo "$item_json" | jq -r '.id')
    
    local new_json=""
    local action=""
    
    # Special handling specifically for the 'Notes' property, as it is outside the fields array
    if [[ "$field" == "Notes" || "$field" == "notes" ]]; then
        local current_notes
        # Check if notes currently exist and assign them
        current_notes=$(echo "$item_json" | jq -r '.notes // empty')
        
        # Determine the user's intent based on the value provided
        if [[ -z "$value" ]]; then
            # If value is empty, ask the user if they want to delete it or enter a new one
            if [[ -n "$current_notes" ]]; then
                # Use the framework question module for deletion confirmation
                if lx question "Notes exist. Do you want to delete them? (No = set new value)" --default-no; then
                    action="remove"
                else
                    action="update"
                fi
            else
                action="add"
            fi
            
            # If the user does not want to remove it, prompt for the new text
            if [[ "$action" != "remove" ]]; then
                if ! lx input --prompt "Enter new Notes:" @value; then
                    output --error "Input cancelled."
                    exit 1
                fi
                
                # Check again if the input was empty to safely fallback to remove mode
                if [[ -z "$value" ]]; then
                    action="remove"
                fi
            fi
        else
            # Value is already provided directly via CLI arguments
            action="update"
        fi
        
        # Apply the requested changes to the JSON structure mapping for notes
        if [[ "$action" == "remove" ]]; then
            new_json=$(echo "$item_json" | jq 'del(.notes)')
            output --info "Removing notes..."
        else
            new_json=$(echo "$item_json" | jq --arg val "$value" '.notes = $val')
            output --info "Updating notes..."
        fi
        
    else
        # Regular handling flow for standard Custom Fields
        local exists
        # Evaluate how many fields match the requested custom name
        exists=$(echo "$item_json" | jq --arg name "$field" '[.fields[] | select(.name == $name)] | length')
        
        # Determine whether to add or update based on its existence in the array
        if [[ "$exists" -gt 0 ]]; then
            action="update"
        else
            action="add"
        fi
        
        # Determine specific value logic and prompt for deletion if explicitly left empty
        if [[ -z "$value" ]]; then
            if [[ "$action" == "update" ]]; then
                # Field exists but value is empty: Prompt to verify deletion
                if lx question "Field '$field' exists. Delete it? (No = set new value)" --default-no; then
                    action="remove"
                else
                    # Retrieve the new value, hiding the input if it's a secure field
                    if [[ "$type" == "hidden" ]]; then
                        lx input --prompt "Enter hidden value:" --password @value
                    else
                        lx input --prompt "Enter value:" @value
                    fi
                    
                    # If the user still provides an empty string, fallback to removal
                    if [[ -z "$value" ]]; then
                        action="remove"
                    fi
                fi
            else
                # Field is entirely new, simply prompt for its initial value
                if [[ "$type" == "hidden" ]]; then
                    lx input --prompt "Enter hidden value:" --password @value
                else
                    lx input --prompt "Enter value:" @value
                fi
                
                # Abort processing if they leave the new field completely empty
                if [[ -z "$value" ]]; then
                    output --error "Value cannot be empty for a new field."
                    exit 1
                fi
            fi
        fi
        
        # Convert the string enum type into Bitwarden's standard numerical format
        local type_num=0
        case "$type" in
            hidden) type_num=1 ;; # Password field
            bool) type_num=2 ;;   # Boolean field
            *) type_num=0 ;;      # Default Text field
        esac
        
        # Construct the deeply modified JSON payload based on the determined action
        if [[ "$action" == "remove" ]]; then
            new_json=$(echo "$item_json" | jq --arg name "$field" 'del(.fields[] | select(.name == $name))')
            output --info "Removing field '$field'..."
        elif [[ "$action" == "add" ]]; then
            new_json=$(echo "$item_json" | jq \
                --arg name "$field" \
                --arg value "$value" \
                --argjson type "$type_num" \
                '.fields += [{"name": $name, "value": $value, "type": $type}]')
            output --info "Adding field '$field'..."
        else
            # Default to update strategy
            new_json=$(echo "$item_json" | jq \
                --arg name "$field" \
                --arg value "$value" \
                '(.fields[] | select(.name == $name).value) |= $value')
            output --info "Updating field '$field'..."
        fi
    fi
    
    # Apply the final encoded JSON to the Bitwarden CLI over 'edit'
    if echo "$new_json" | bw encode | bw edit item "$item_id" > /dev/null; then
        if [[ "$action" == "remove" ]]; then
            output --ok "Successfully removed '$field'."
        else
            output --ok "Successfully saved '$field'."
        fi
    else
        output --error "Failed to save changes to Bitwarden."
        exit 1
    fi
}
